description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Sweet Summertime”, where beach days and breezy nights come to life in WaterColor’s Crossings District. Just a 3-min walk from Dragonfly Pool and a casual ride to Camp WaterColor’s lazy river, this 4-bedroom retreat radiates coastal charm with its inviting spaces and screened porch made for sunset chats. Cruise the scenic paths with 6 bikes, hop in the LSV, and soak up the magic of 30A’s beaches, eats, and good vibes. Your perfect getaway starts here! Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Easy Steps to Dragonfly Pool – Enjoy a short, relaxing 3-minute walk to the serene Dragonfly Pool, perfect for unwinding under the sun.Includes 6 Bikes + LSV – Explore the area with ease using the 6 provided bikes or the convenient Low-Speed Vehicle (LSV) for fun and effortless adventures.Quick Ride to Lazy River & Beach – Experience the ultimate vacation vibe with just a short ride to the tranquil Lazy River or the sandy, sun-soaked beach.Chef’s Kitchen with Premium Features – Cook like a pro in the fully equipped Chef's kitchen, featuring new countertops and GE Monogram stainless steel appliances.Family-Friendly with 4 Bedrooms for 10 Guests – Spacious and cozy, this home comfortably hosts up to 10 guests, making it ideal for quality family time or group getaways.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The property was exactly as described—spacious and just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for large groups!" – Michael⭐ "Great location and plenty of space for our family! Would highly recommend for a relaxing stay near the beach." – Amir⭐ "Beautiful home with lots of space and attentive management. Loved the short walk to the beach and the included bikes!" – Maegan*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in bright, coastal-inspired spaces designed for unforgettable family gatherings. The airy open floor plan seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating the perfect flow for entertaining. Step out onto the screened porch and soak in serene park views, adding a touch of tranquility to your stay.Spacious Open Layout Perfect for Relaxation and Entertaining GuestsSleek Smart TV Ideal for Cozy Family Movie NightsCharming Screened Porch with Peaceful Views of Lush Green Space*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***A fully equipped kitchen featuring premium GE Monogram appliances transforms cooking into an effortless and enjoyable experience. Savor your meals at the spacious dining table or the stylish breakfast bar, perfect for casual mornings or lively gatherings.Premium GE Monogram Appliances for a Modern TouchExpansive Dining Table for 6 Perfect for Gatherings and Group MealsStylish Breakfast Bar Ideal for Casual Dining and Morning Coffee for 3*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Immerse yourself in the magic of WaterColor, where a cozy screened porch invites relaxation, sparkling pools are just steps away, and endless coastal adventures await. Explore the scenic beauty on bikes or cruise effortlessly in a low-speed vehicle (LSV) for an unforgettable getaway.Relax on the Screened Porch Overlooking Stunning Park ViewsJust a 2-Minute Walk to the Beautiful Dragonfly PoolExplore in Style with 6 Bikes and a Luxury LSV Included*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bathroom: Perfectly placed for guest convenience2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: Spacious King Bed, exclusive Private Porch, luxurious En-Suite featuring a Rain Shower and Freestanding Tub for ultimate relaxationKing Guest Suite: Elegant King Bed with its own private En-Suite BathroomQueen Guest Suite: Cozy Queen Bed, sharing a well-appointed bathroomBunk Room: Fun Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed with a handy Trundle, ideal for kids or extra guests, sharing a bathroom*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of WaterColor's Crossings District, this home offers the perfect blend of convenience and charm. Just moments away from 30A’s stunning beaches, scenic trails, and top-rated restaurants, it’s the ideal spot to immerse yourself in everything this vibrant area has to offer!Dragonfly Pool – A tranquil retreat for a refreshing dip, just a 3-minute walk from your door.Camp WaterColor (with Lazy River) – A family-friendly oasis with a relaxing lazy river and fun amenities. A quick 4-minute bike ride away.Seaside Town Center – Charming and vibrant, filled with unique shops, delicious eateries, and a lively beach town atmosphere. Only 7 minutes by bike.Grayton Beach State Park – A serene escape into nature, perfect for hiking, picnics, or soaking up the sun. Just 10 minutes by car.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 86842STRO #: STR-086842
